description: Replacement ATV tyres were not available through normal channels in Resolute.
response: The XO negotiated the loan of two matching tyres and rims from a local contact. Tyres were returned at the end of the mission.
lesson: Identify ATV tyre sizes and thread specifications before departure; attempt to ship via the Mars Society. Develop and maintain a local contact network in Resolute — the Mars Society relationship is the entry point.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.6 Logistics and safety, lines 809-814. Register Crew tag: 'C16'. Sol: not stated; placed within the same pre-sim ATV-triage window documented elsewhere for this mission. Confidence (C) rationale: named XO negotiating an external arrangement — reads as an XO-report style account. system_category note: register's own category for this entry is 'Logistics' (a procurement/supply-chain issue), kept as Logistics over ATVs/Transport since the failure is sourcing availability, not a mechanical fault.
